mapper.select: SELECT P.PURCHASE_NO, P.COMPLETE_DATE, P.IN_DATE , C.CLIENT_NO, C.CLIENT_NAME, C.CLIENT_ADDRESS, C.CLIENT_EMAIL , C.CLIENT_TEL, C.CLIENT_MAN, E.EMP_NO, E.EMP_NAME , I.PURCHASE_ITEM_CNT, I.PURCHASE_ITEM_INCNT, I.PURCHASE_ITEM_COST , PA.PARTS_NO, PA.PARTS_NAME FROM PURCHASE_ORDER P LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON P.CLIENT_NO = C.CLIENT_NO LEFT JOIN EMP E ON P.EMP_NO = E.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN PURCHASE_ITEM I ON P.PURCHASE_NO = I.PURCHASE_NO LEFT JOIN PARTS PA ON I.PARTS_NO = PA.PARTS_NO WHERE P.PURCHASE_NO = #{value}
